## (a) + host-decode tests: Chirp PR #44 (https://github.com/pablof7z/chirp/pull/44)
- Committed the real-shell C-ABI guard `chirp_difference_home_feed_surfaces_followed_author_notes` (full compose + `nmp_app_open_feed` JSON-marshaled difference feed + `decode_op_feed_snapshot` → followed non-self author's notes surface).
- Added the host live-path tests that cover the exact gap the golden fixtures skip (Android `OpFeedDecoderTest`, both PASS on `:app:testDebugUnitTest`, no device):
  - `homeFeedLivePathFreezesOnStuckProjectionRev` — reproduces the device freeze through `ProjectionMergeCache.merge` → `TypedHomeFeedDecoder.decode` with a stuck rev.
  - `homeFeedLivePathRendersOnAdvancingProjectionRev` — an advancing rev (what #2952 now emits) renders the 2 cards.

## Bottom line / next
The empty home feed resolves once NMP #2952 merges and Chirp re-pins NMP. No Swift/Kotlin change required. A device re-verify screenshot after the re-pin would confirm the final render — route the device agent then (there's nothing device-specific left to find; it's purely the re-pin). PRs: NMP #2952 (the fix), Chirp #44 (the guards). Do you want me to also open the chirp#39 close on the re-pin, or leave that to the platform agent?
